title: Polish Tripe Tagine
description: A sour and hearty Polish dish made with tripe, cooked in a tagine and flavored with traditional spices, this recipe is kid-friendly and easy to make.

ingredients.name: tripe
ingredients.notes: beef tripe, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tripe, caraway seeds, marjoram, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the tripe is tender.
Stir in the sour cream and lemon juice.
Simmer the tagine for an additional 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill.
